0.0: I can't believe the herbs have been stolen again. This is not doing justice to all the good folks at #m250000000#... Don't you think so? Hmmm? Hey, you're not from here... you look like you have no clue what I've just talked about. Do you want to hear a story?

yes.0: #b#m251000000##k, a beautiful town right next to #m250000000#, is renowned for herbs. That holds especially true for Mr. Koo, who has the best set of... never... nevermind. Lately, however, I've seen some weird pirates setting up a lair, and pillaging ships that transport herbs between the towns.
yes.1: It's because of these pirates that supplies from #m251000000# have disappeared. And, since I'm in charge of freight from #m251000000# to #m250000000#, I have to take care of the problem. If you could help me with these pirates, it would be very much appreciated.

no.0: There's no reason for you to concern yourself with the small problems of our town...

1.0: Welcome to #m251000000#. Unfortunately, things are not looking up here, so I also suggest you to do the same. What? #p2091002# sent you here?

yes.0: From what I see through your clothes and armors, you definitely look like an experienced traveler. This may not be an easy task, though. Can you do it?

npc.0: Have you not run into #b#p2092001##k, yet? #p2092001# may be currently moving freights at #b#m251000000##k, but he used to be a famous traveler from back in the day.

QuestInfo.name: Tae Sang's Request
QuestInfo.0: The resident pharmacist of #b#m250000000##k, #b#p2091002##k, would like to request something. I wonder what that is...
QuestInfo.1: #p2091002# talked to me about the dastardly ways the #rRed-Nosed Pirates#k used to steal some herbs by attacking the ships traveling from #m250000000# to #m251000000#. He asked me to join forces with #b#p2092001##k, who's in charge of freight on #b#m251000000##k and protect it.
QuestInfo.2:
#b#p2092001##k appears to be a seasoned crewman. Defeating Lord Pirate's subordinates will be easy if you team up with him...
